description: Open a support ticket in your user's AlterLab account when they need a human (billing, account or data problem), then follow up on it. Not for scrape friction, blocks or ideas: use `alterlab_feedback`. `subject` + `body` opens a ticket; ask the user first: a ticket reaches a human and emails them. `ticket_ref` (e.g. ALT-1234) alone reads the thread: status, `waiting_on` and public replies. `ticket_ref` + `message` posts a reply; reply on the existing ticket instead of opening a new one. No arguments lists your agent tickets. Requires an API key. Do not include secrets, API keys, passwords or customer data. Limits: 3 open tickets and 5 per day per key (the error points to the open ticket), 30 replies per hour. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

body.description: What the user needs help with (new ticket)

message.description: Follow-up reply to post on ticket_ref

on_behalf_of_user.description: True when the user asked you to file this. Default: true

ticket_ref.description: Ticket reference such as ALT-1234 returned when the ticket was opened; alone it reads the thread

tool_name.description: Tool or endpoint the ticket is about

name: alterlab_support_ticket
title: Open Support Ticket
